design: Deliberately crude fictional world: uneven ink coastlines, flat blue sea, simple continent blocks and sparse real-banknote accents. No animals, landmarks or realistic ocean photograph.

heroBanknote.orientation: Front-facing rectangular paper, 20-degree in-plane rotation; no perspective distortion
heroBanknote.corner: Points at the fictional Korean peninsula

portraitPolicy: Sejong retained. Chinese and US political portraits excluded by using reverse sides. Other accents use architecture, numerals or portrait-free crops.
interaction: First tap: note shrinks into Korea in about 410ms
Continents and sea perimeter interpolate from globe into a flat map; total about 1290ms
Tap the unfolded map or Start exchange to enter application step 01/04
Replay restores and repeats the reveal
accessibility: Native buttons, expanded/busy state and translated instructions. Reduced-motion mode implements an immediate transition; not separately browser-emulation-tested.
scope: Local prototype only. No Git push or publication in this revision. Existing banknote photograph provenance is retained under currency-atlas.
